name: Camp Tevya
description_short: A co-ed Jewish overnight camp on Lake Potanipo in Brookline, New Hampshire, running since 1940. It offers 3.5-week and 7-week sessions with Jewish life, waterfront, sports and arts activities.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Lake Potanipo, and campers swim and paddle there. The page gives no details on swim instruction, testing or lifeguarding.
